docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A hundred and more verses of Sūrdās on Uddhava's message to the gopīs, chosen from the Sūrsāgar and edited with a long introduction by Ramchandra Shukla (1926).

From Wikisource · Public domain

Sūrdās (sixteenth century), Bhramargīt-sār, edited by Ramchandra Shukla (1884–1941), Nagari Pracharini Sabha, 1926, as transcribed on Hindi Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain. Modified: converted to this format.
